tools.name: migrate_export_dns_zone
tools.description: Export a DNS zone with all its records as a migration bundle (JSON).
tools.title: Export DNS Zone

include_secrets.description: Include password hashes and other secrets in the bundle (default false: redacted; refused in read-only mode)

tools.name: migrate_export_mail_domain
tools.description: Export a mail domain with all mailboxes, aliases, forwards, and catchall as a migration bundle.
tools.title: Export Mail Domain

include_secrets.description: Include password hashes and other secrets in the bundle (default false: redacted; refused in read-only mode)

tools.name: migrate_export_web_domain
tools.description: Export a web domain with FTP users, shell users, databases, cron jobs, and subdomains as a migration bundle.
tools.title: Export Website

include_secrets.description: Include password hashes and other secrets in the bundle (default false: redacted; refused in read-only mode)

tools.name: migrate_export_client
tools.description: Export a client account with all associated domains as a migration bundle.
tools.title: Export Client

include_secrets.description: Include password hashes and other secrets in the bundle (default false: redacted; refused in read-only mode)

tools.name: migrate_plan
tools.description: Generate a migration plan: inventory what exists on the source. Does NOT make any changes.
tools.title: Plan Migration

tools.name: migrate_data_commands
tools.description: Generate rsync/mysqldump commands needed to transfer actual data (files, mail, databases) between servers. These commands must be run manually — the MCP handles config only.
tools.title: Generate Data Transfer Commands

tools.name: migrate_verify
tools.description: Compare source and destination ISPConfig instances after migration. Requires ISPCONFIG_DEST_URL.
tools.title: Verify Migration

tools.name: migrate_import_dns_zone
tools.description: Import a DNS zone migration bundle into the destination ISPConfig instance. Requires ISPCONFIG_DEST_URL to be configured.
tools.title: Import DNS Zone

dest_server_id.description: Target server ID on the destination instance

tools.name: migrate_import_mail_domain
tools.description: Import a mail domain migration bundle into the destination ISPConfig instance. Creates domain, mailboxes, aliases, and forwards. NOTE: maildir data must be rsynced separately; redacted passwords must be reset.
tools.title: Import Mail Domain

dest_server_id.description: Target server ID on the destination instance

tools.name: migrate_import_web_domain
tools.description: Import a web domain migration bundle into the destination ISPConfig instance. Creates site, FTP/shell users, databases, cron jobs. NOTE: Website files and DB dumps must be transferred separately. Destructive: confirm with the user before calling.
tools.title: Import Website

dest_server_id.description: Target server ID on the destination instance
